args.title: Use configured app URL in password reset email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured application URL from the `config` module (e.g. `config.appUrl` or similar config settings) rather than `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` defaulting to `localhost:3000`, so password reset emails point to the correct production domain.
